label: Pepe's Piri Piri UK official Nutrition & Allergens page — server-rendered per-item nutrition cards
notes: Static HTML, no JS needed: each product is a <div data-adam="adam" data-title="..."> card containing .ntc-item blocks for Kcal, Fat, Saturated Fat, Carbohydrates, Sugars, Protein, Salt, plus allergens and a category. 162 cards on the page, 129 with both Kcal and Protein parsed (the remainder are cards where the Kcal/Protein cells are blank at source). Plausibility check protein*4 <= kcal*1.15 passed on all 129 (0 violations). Names contain HTML entities at source (e.g. –) — unescaped here. There is a parallel Ireland page at /nutrition-allergens-ireland/ if the ROI menu is ever needed.
